title: An optimized protocol for phenotyping human granulocytes by mass cytometry
protocol: Warm whole blood in 37°C water bath for 30 s.
Pipette 1 mL of whole blood into 5 mL snap cap tubes with the following stimulants: RPMI (control, without stimulation).
Pipette 1 mL of 2 μg/mL anti-IgE in RPMI into another tube.
Pipette 1 mL of 4 ng/mL IL-3 in RPMI into a third tube.
Incubate sample tubes at 37°C for 30 min in 5% CO2 incubator.
Transfer contents of each tube to corresponding 50 mL falcon tubes.
Add 20 mL of cold 1× RBC lysis buffer to each tube.
Incubate tubes for 15 min in the dark on ice.
Stop RBC lysis by adding 20 mL cold dPBS + 2 mM EDTA to each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 350 × g, 5 min, at 4°C.
Aspirate most of supernatant from tubes, leaving behind approximately 100 μL in which the pellet of cells can be dissolved by tapping the tube.
Add 20 mL dPBS + EDTA to each tube, making sure cells are fully resuspended.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate most of the supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the remaining fluid by tapping the tube.
Add 3 mL of CSM to each tube and transfer their contents to corresponding FACS tubes.
Count cells using a hemacytometer after RBC lysis; ensure there are around 10 million cells per tube.
Spin the tubes for 5 minutes at 350 × g at 4°C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant, leaving residual supernatant to avoid disrupting the cell pellet.
Tap the tube to dissolve cells in solution.
Add 2.5 μL of Human TruStain FcX (BioLegend) solution to each tube.
Tap the tube to mix thoroughly.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 20°C–23°C.
Add 52.5 μL of the surface antibody cocktail to each tube.
Tap tubes to resuspend cells and prevent clumps.
Incubate tubes at 20°C–23°C for 30 minutes.
To each sample tube, add 899 μL of low barium PBS.
Add 1 μL of 0.5 mM cisplatin to each tube.
Vortex briefly and incubate for 5 minutes at 20°C–23°C.
Add 4 mL of CSM buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 250 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant, leaving behind approximately 100 μL.
Resuspend cell pellet by tapping the tube.
Add 900 μL of CSM buffer and 100 μL of 16% PFA to each tube.
Incubate tubes at 20°C–23°C for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the tubes at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving behind approximately 100 μL.
Resuspend the cells in the residual volume by tapping the tube.
Add 4 mL of CSM.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving behind approximately 100 μL.
Tapping all sample tubes to resuspend cell pellet.
Add 1 mL of 4°C 100% MeOH.
Incubate on ice for exactly 10 min.
Immediately add 3 mL of CSM to stop further permeabilization.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL of residual volume.
Resuspend cell pellet by tapping and repeat pelleting steps.
Bring supernatant to appropriate volume for intracellular staining.
Add the necessary volume of intracellular antibody cocktail into each tube.
Incubate for 30 min at 20°C–23°C.
Add 3 mL of CSM buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL of residual volume.
Resuspend pellet by tapping and add DNA intercalator solution to each tube.
Leave at 4°C for at least 16 h or for 20 min at 20°C–23°C if running samples on the CyTOF the same day.
Place cells with DNA intercalator solution at 4°C until sample is processed.
Add 4 mL of CSM buffer to each sample tube at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet by tapping tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant leaving approximately 100 μL of residual volume.
Resuspend pellet by tapping tube and add 4 mL of filtered double-distilled water.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant leaving approximately 100 μL of residual volume.
Repeat steps 42–43.
Dilute EQ Four Element Calibration Beads 10-fold in filtered double-distilled water and keep at 4°C.
Count cells with hemacytometer.
Immediately before analysis, resuspend pellet by tapping tube and add diluted EQ beads to reach a cell density of 1 million cells per mL.
Filter sample using a Falcon round-bottom tube with cell strainer (35 μm) to avoid clogging the CyTOF or nebulizer.
Acquire cells at an event rate of less than 500 per second to avoid doublets.
If the event rate is higher than 500 per second, further dilute the cell solution with EQ bead/water mixture.
Keep samples on ice until their acquisition.
Reconstitute FCS files through a MATLAB-based bead normalization software.
Upload processed FCS files to Cytobank for gating.
Process individual immune cell types using R to quantile normalize protein expression by donor.
Apply an inverse hyperbolic sine (arcsinh) transformation with a cofactor of 5 to the data.
Use Scanpy’s Python-based implementation to carry out dimensionality reduction via tSNE.
Cluster cells using the Leiden algorithm in Scanpy.
